verdict.rationale: Postman's navigation docs list an API Catalog and a Private API Network alongside Workspaces, which points to an internal API directory. Internal workspaces let teams share and version API work, and role and permission controls apply at the team, workspace, and element levels. The evidence for the catalog itself is only a menu-item mention, and the API-sharing text found refers to the public network rather than an internal portal. Missing for 10: documentation of how to publish APIs to the Private API Network or Catalog, how consumers discover and onboard to internal APIs, portal customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
